job.does: Every day it reads the price on your product page, and when it is at or below your target it asks you on Telegram whether to send a reminder to buy it.
job.done: The price was checked, and a reminder went out only if you said yes.

settings.label: The product page
settings.help: The page whose price it reads.

settings.label: Your target price
settings.help: It asks you when the price is at or below this.

steps.title: Read the price
steps.description: Fetch settings.product_url and find the price on the page: the first amount after a currency sign. Return price as a number, or null when there is none. Also return price_way: "low" when the price is at or below settings.target_price, else "not_low".

steps.title: At or below your target?
steps.prompt: Is the price at or below the target?

steps.title: Write the question
steps.description: Return question as telegram.ask's arguments: the price, the target and the page, asking whether to send a reminder to buy it, with the choices Yes and No.

steps.title: Write the reminder
steps.description: Return reminder as telegram.send's arguments: a reminder to buy it, with the price and the page.

actions.description: Ask you whether to send a reminder to buy it
Send you the reminder to buy it

plain.text: At or below your target? If above the target, it stops there.
Ask you whether to send a reminder to buy it
Did you say yes? If no, it stops there.
Send you the reminder to buy it

story: Passed. It read the page, asked you on Telegram "The price is now 42, at or below your target of 50. Send you a reminder to buy it? http..." (you answered "Yes") and sent you "Reminder: buy it now at 42. https://shop.example/kettle" on Telegram.
